appearance_facts.fact: Single blue line with circular markers spans 2006-2018; light purple fill covers the area between the line and the top axis (0). The line sits in the lower portion of the plot (y between ~8 and ~9.5). The 2010 marker is the highest point on the line (closest to the top axis / smallest Count value). The 2018 marker is the lowest point on the line (farthest from the top axis / largest Count value). The 2015 marker is also near the bottom of the line.

printed_facts.fact: Y-axis label 'Count'; ticks 0, 2, 4, 6, 8 (0 at top, increasing downward)

Primary field 'Peak-burden year follow-up route'; options: 'Escalate 2018 for annual mortality peak follow-up', 'Escalate 2010 for annual mortality peak follow-up', 'Escalate chart for methodology reference review'

public_definitions: Task: 'Use the yearly mortality trend in the chart to determine which reporting year warrants escalation, then select the corresponding routing option.'
Scope: 'Annual peak-burden routing' / 'Yearly mortality escalation review'
Applicable condition: select the year that should receive peak-burden follow-up based on the chart trend.
uncertain: The y-axis is labeled 'Count' with 0 at the top and increasing downward, while the title says 'Mortality rate'; the mapping of 'peak-burden' to a high vs. low position on this inverted axis is not explicitly defined on the page.
No numeric value labels are printed on the line markers, so exact per-year values are not available; relative heights (2010 highest on line, 2018 lowest on line) are visual readings.
